en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a prominent ornate town‑hall–like building featuring a clock tower, spires, and a tall weather vane. The ground floor has arched windows and an awning-covered entrance, and there are several attached buildings along the street in similar historicist style. In the foreground stand children, a horse and cart, and a few pedestrians, evoking a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century scene.
